source_findings: The schedule contains exactly 27 unique dataset/variant/seed combinations: RGBNT201, RGBNT100 and MSVR310; demo, ordinary and dual; seeds 42, 43 and 44. Host 2025 has 13 and host 2026 has 14.
missing_evaluation.py:15-22 zeros exactly RGB, NI, TI, RGB+NI, RGB+TI or NI+TI. It operates after the normal loader has converted and normalized the inputs. Clean masking is a no-op.

The six mappings agree with the original DeMo evaluation branches in modeling/make_model.py:142-156. verify_original_mask compares real raw descriptors with torch.equal, restores miss_type after each successful comparison, and fails on a discrepancy.

missing_evaluation.py requires training COMPLETE and exit0, reconstructs the existing configuration, strictly loads best.pth, and calls model.eval(). Extraction and mask verification use torch.no_grad(). No optimizer, training step, checkpoint update or official-test selection is introduced.

The existing training entry selects the earliest maximal development-mAP checkpoint over 50 epochs. Missing evaluation reads that checkpoint and selected epoch; it does not choose among test conditions or seeds.

Official records come from the existing dataset parsers. Retrieval metrics compare against dataset identity labels and exclude same-ID/same-camera entries for RGBNT and same-ID/same-scene entries for MSVR310. The same full_metrics and distance implementations are reused.

Each run recomputes clean query/gallery features, checks all six clean metrics against the completed normal full evaluation, then scores both-missing with the same missing set on each side and query-only against the reused clean gallery. Exactly 13 conditions are required.

The launcher waits 240 seconds for predecessor receipts and busy GPUs, launches only below 500 MiB, and uses at most four slots per host. There is no kill, preemption, checkpoint migration or failed-run retry path.

Existing missing results are reused only with missing_exit exit0 and result status COMPLETE. Exclusive stdout creation and exclusive result-directory creation preserve partial attempts; failed receipts stop their slot.

The collector retains all 351 raw six-metric rows, 117 three-seed aggregates with sample standard deviations, 117 per-seed comparisons, and 39 mean comparisons. It aligns query identity, name, camera, scene, index and validity before both harm/rescue comparisons.

The collector requires every condition, selected-epoch consistency, original-mask checks for all nine DeMo checkpoints, identical query/gallery counts, and all six clean-metric matches. It publishes only after the existing full-suite writer's terminal marker. Incomplete one-shot collection and failed runs do not invoke publication.

The recorded protocol explicitly describes zero-input robustness of checkpoints trained with full modalities on the fit subset. It does not claim learned availability masking, missing-modality training, a full official-train reproduction, or test-time adaptation.

The later residual candidate edit adds an import and new variant dispatch in run_experiment.py. Configuration and evaluation are unchanged in the diff. The new imported module contains imports and class/function definitions only; its model constructors are not called at import. Its training loss changes are not reached by missing evaluation. The residual candidate method itself is outside this review.

source_findings: Each dataset/variant has separate both and query protocol rows. Prefix filtering selects exactly six missing conditions and excludes clean.

For each metric, the implementation first takes the equal-weight mean of six conditions within seed 42, 43 and 44. It retains those three values, then reports their mean and sample standard deviation.
There are 18 macro rows: 3 datasets x 3 variants x 2 protocols. The existing 27 runs, 351 raw condition rows, 117 per-condition aggregates and 39 strict condition comparisons remain unchanged.

The two global two-percentage-point acceptance flags still depend on every per-condition comparison, not on the macro averages. The handoff table explicitly describes the averaging order and states that macro averages do not replace individual-condition acceptance.
The change adds a report field and table only; it does not change inputs, checkpoints, masks, metrics, seed selection or evaluation scheduling.

Every eventual run must independently pass its clean six-metric check; all nine DeMo runs must retain the original-mask batch check. Require all 27 exit0/COMPLETE results and all 351 conditions before claiming campaign completion.
